value.name: Hello, Love... Collection
value.overview: A collection of movies starring Kathryn Bernardo's Joy and Alden Richards' Ethan.

parts.title: Hello, Love, Again
parts.overview: Five years on from when Joy said goodbye to Ethan and Hong Kong to pursue her dreams in Canada. After fighting for their love to conquer the time, distance and a global shutdown that kept them apart, Joy and Ethan meet again in Canada but realize that they have also changed a lot, individually.

parts.title: Hello, Love, Goodbye
parts.overview: A bartender and a domestic helper of Filipino origin living in Hong Kong find themselves falling in love, but they each have different plans for their future.
